title: Cursor transcript-derived prompts leak <timestamp> wrapper tags

verdict.rationale: The evidence shows StripIDEContextTags was extended to strip system tags like <local-command-caveat> and <system-reminder> for Claude transcripts. Nothing mentions Cursor's <timestamp> wrapper, so its omission was never chosen; it is simply an uncovered tag.
